title: WL94D - sharp sender oracle-supervised smoke: direct M64 supervision of the learned S1 once-scattered sender (continuation of WL94C D)
brief: user brief 'WL94D - Sharp Sender Oracle-Supervised Smoke' (2026-11-15)
batch_class: suffix of WL94 (bounded continuation of WL94C under the preserved ECRO contract; adds one source-specific teacher term). Named WL94D by the brief; the owner decides.

hypothesis.H-S: the existing ECRO sender representation reproduces the sharp-panel response more faithfully when trained against a physically matched source-specific oracle

sender_contract.learned: model86.ECRO.apply, single term: u = c^T s, Bq = a u per patch (rank R = 16 local operator A_n = a_n c_n^T, geometry-conditioned through the patch tokens). On the S1 panel patches this is the learned sharp-panel once-scattered sender.
sender_contract.exact: Bm = s M64[material] (diag92.local_matrices -> quad87 enc_matrix; mat94.mq_ext adds the WL94 Lambert ids). mat94.arm_tables C2_srcS1 substitutes Bm for Bl on the S1 patches: the established exact-panel-sender positive control.
sender_contract.match: same patches (rect 5, PSID 5, material 1), same incident field s [L, N, 64 incident bins, 3] (ctx.source / the stored item field), same 64 outgoing bins and patch frames, same radiance units: Bl and Bm enter the identical flight / receiver code. No new head: the teacher reads the existing internal Bq.
sender_contract.not_used: the noisy MC e2_p receiver label is NOT used as the sender target (aggregate e2 vs isolated e2_p is not supervised)

stage_A.T_SEM: on CK2, the C2_srcS1 single flight rebuilt from my Bm path equals the stored WL94C D table (rel max <= 1e-5); my Bl path through the flight equals model.apply's single term (<= 1e-5)
stage_A.G_PHYS: on the 96 training items, the exact S1 sender + exact receiver single-flight exitance per (lighting, receiver patch) vs the WL94B e2_p path label: pooled ratio in [0.8, 1.25] AND corr(exact, label) >= corr(label 256 spp, independent label 64 spp) (agreement at least at the label's own reliability). Revised before the freeze: the first draft required corr >= 0.9 and failed (corr 0.641, ratio 0.953) because the sharp-reflector e2_p label is noise-limited (reliability corr 0.525). The CK2 2 x 4,096-spp comparison is reported as a diagnostic of the 64-bin flight floor (not a gate).
stage_A.coverage: incident bins at the panel excited by the training fields vs validation and CK2 fields. Pre-freeze finding: all 64 incident bins are excited in training (val 62, CK2 4, none outside training), so there are no bin-level held-out incident directions; generalization is measured on held-out geometries / lights (val split) and CK2 fields, and the operator matrix error is reported over all bins.
stage_A.on_failure: T_SEM or G_PHYS failure = SOURCE_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE (stop); other = STOP_TEST

candidates.init: WL94C D_s<seed> (final state), for every candidate
candidates.stream: WL94C D objective unchanged (q94.wobjective with the WL94C D query weights), WL94A C items (50/50 materials, cached targets), order rng(seed + 9400)
candidates.budget: 1,000 steps each (half of one WL94 smoke run); Adam lr 1e-4, warm-up 100, cosine to 1e-5, clip 10; no extension
candidates.T: + lam_T x teacher on the 42 S1 panel patches
candidates.R: + lam_R x teacher on all 1,228 non-S1 patches (matched oracle-supervision control: same rule, same exact-operator semantics, other sources)
candidates.teacher: mean over (lighting, patch in set, outgoing bin, channel) of ((Bl - Bm) / den)^2, den = bin mean of Bm per (lighting, patch, channel) + 0.05 x mean of Bm over the set (the OWN normalisation form)
candidates.lam_rule: lam_X = mean ||grad OWN-D objective|| / mean ||grad teacher_X|| at the D_s<seed> init over the first 16 training items: the teacher contributes an initial gradient norm equal to the whole existing objective. One rule; computed in the chain before training (recorded pre-freeze in feasibility_result); not tuned.

evaluation.models: own (frozen anchor), D (WL94C), T, R, P; D with the exact S1 sender (WL94C C2_srcS1 renders) as positive control; C2_srcS1 renders also for T / R / P
evaluation.sender_standalone: S1 field Bl vs Bm (flux-weighted rel L1, energy ratio, peak-bin ratio) on the 96 training items (training fields), the 24 validation items (held-out geometries / lights, WL86 val split) and CK2 (evaluation only); delivery = learned vs exact S1 sender single flight through the exact receiver (all receivers / box); S1 local operator matrix vs M64 per val geometry and CK2, flux-transfer weighted, split into incident bins excited in training vs never excited
evaluation.integrated: WL94B / WL94C metrics: untextured / textured ROI_T E_H + signed + noise bound, panel-face sender / G, CK2 amplitudes, texture response, V_orig / V_ck
evaluation.noise: sender fields are deterministic (no MC); image tolerance max(2 x noise bound, 0.005)

criteria.SENDER_IMP: per seed: sender rel L1 (val) of T <= 0.8 x min(R, P) AND sender rel L1 (CK2) of T <= 0.8 x min(R, P)
criteria.RENDER_IMP: per seed: untextured ROI_T E_H of T better than P AND better than R by more than tol
criteria.KEEP: per seed: T passes F2 (V_orig <= 1.10 x frozen own's V_orig) and MR (WL94A)

outcome.SENDER_AND_RENDER_IMPROVED: SENDER_IMP AND RENDER_IMP AND KEEP on both seeds
outcome.SENDER_FIT_ONLY: SENDER_IMP on both seeds AND RENDER_IMP on neither
outcome.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else (seed disagreement, partial, non-finite, init mismatch)

answers_mapping: supervisable = Stage A; fit = T training-field sender error and operator error on trained bins vs D / P; generalization = val / CK2 field errors and never-excited-bin operator error vs D / P; both seeds = SENDER_IMP / RENDER_IMP per seed; global / F2 / MR = panel-face G and KEEP; gap to exact sender = E_H(T) - E_H(D with exact S1 sender)
pre_freeze_exposure: All WL94-WL94C results are known. Pre-freeze feasibility (no training) ran the Stage A audit twice in ~/rest_x94dfeas plus one diagnostic probe (G_PHYS noise reliability and the CK2 flight-floor comparison, values recorded in feasibility_result); the first G_PHYS draft failed and was revised as disclosed in stage_A.G_PHYS. Dev chain ~/rest_x94ddev (60 steps, 32-spp renders): run 1 failed with CUDA OOM (10 concurrent processes on the 12 GB GPU) -> the chain now runs at most 4 CUDA processes; run 2 completed end to end. Dev candidate outputs (tables, sender evaluations, renders, analysis, figures, final label) were not opened.

feasibility_result.run: ~/rest_x94dfeas (run 2, revised G_PHYS): REPRO PASS, AUDIT94D PASS
feasibility_result.T_SEM: C2_srcS1 rebuilt from the Bm path vs stored WL94C D tables 7.6e-8 / 6.0e-8; Bl path vs model.apply 0.0
feasibility_result.G_PHYS: training items: pooled ratio 0.953; corr exact vs 256-spp label 0.641 >= label reliability 0.525 (256 vs 64 spp); run 1 with corr >= 0.9 failed and is disclosed
feasibility_result.CK2_flight_floor_diagnostic: exact S1 sender + exact receiver vs the 2 x 4,096-spp e2_p reference: receivers ratio 1.38 / corr 0.71 / rel L1 0.94 (half noise 0.13); box A 1.21 / 0.72 / 0.53 (0.06); panel face 1.21 / corr -0.33 / 0.60 (0.07): the 64-bin flight of a sharp lobe misplaces delivered energy beyond noise (WL90 projection floor). Bm itself is the exact bin-level once-scattered response; the learned and exact sender share this flight, so the attainable target of T is the C2_srcS1 control, not the physical e2_p.
feasibility_result.coverage: all 64 incident bins excited in training; val 62, CK2 4 bins, none outside training (no bin-level held-out directions)
